string-array.name: tips_format
string-array.item: Ask what must be kept. Agree on the reset or reinstall before erasing anything.
Copy important files to a separate drive and open a few to check the copy.
Have the owner check their account access and recovery key if the drive is locked.
Use official installation media for the correct device. Keep the charger connected.
Restore the agreed files. Test startup, Wi-Fi, sound and apps with the customer.

string-array.name: tips_apps
string-array.item: Write down the apps and versions the customer wants.
Check the device has enough space and supports those apps.
Use the official app store or publisher installer. Check any licence with the owner.
Let the customer enter their own passwords. Open each installed app once.
Test the main feature and show the customer where to find the app.

string-array.name: tips_diagnosis
string-array.item: Ask when the problem started and what happened just before it.
Note the model, visible damage, charger and any error message.
Try to repeat the problem. Start with power, cables and a normal restart.
Check one thing at a time and write down the result.
Explain what you found and agree on the next repair and price.

string-array.name: tips_repair
string-array.item: Confirm the fault and record the device condition before starting.
Explain the proposed repair and get the customer to agree to the cost.
Power off and unplug. Use the exact model repair guide for opening and battery isolation.
Keep screws labelled. Only use a compatible part and suitable tools.
Reassemble, repeat the original test and check the other main functions.

string-array.name: tips_cleanup
string-array.item: Ask about noise or overheating and inspect for damage.
Shut down, unplug and follow the device guide before opening it.
Clean the outside with a soft lint-free cloth. Keep liquid out of openings.
Use the maker\'s method for vents and fans. Never spray liquid into the device.
Close everything securely and check fan noise and normal temperature.

string-array.name: tips_backup
string-array.item: Ask exactly which files should move and where they should go.
Check that the destination has enough free space.
Copy the files; keep the original until the customer has checked the copy.
Open sample photos and documents from the new location.
Let the customer confirm their important files and return the backup drive.

string-array.name: tips_security
string-array.item: Ask about unusual pop-ups or apps and protect important files first.
If a break-in is suspected, disconnect the affected device from the network.
Use the built-in security app or a trusted official scanner; run a full scan.
Review unknown apps, browser extensions and notification permissions with the owner.
Restart and test. If an account was exposed, have the owner change its password from a clean device.

string-array.name: tips_upgrade
string-array.item: Check the exact model, supported part type and available slots.
Back up files before changing a storage drive. Agree on the new part and cost.
Shut down and unplug; follow the model guide to isolate the battery and fit the part.
Check the system sees the new memory or drive at the correct capacity.
Test startup and open several files or apps. Return the old part if agreed.

string-array.name: tips_screen
string-array.item: Record the model and test touch, display and cameras before repair.
Check the replacement is compatible and agree on the price.
Power off. Follow the model repair guide; stop if the battery looks damaged.
Keep screws and cables organised; avoid forcing connectors.
Test touch across the screen, brightness, cameras and buttons before handoff.

string-array.name: tips_battery
string-array.item: Ask how long the charge lasts and whether the device gets unusually hot.
Stop using or charging a swollen, leaking or very hot battery. Refer it to a trained battery repairer.
If there is no damage, test with a known-good compatible cable and charger.
Check the charging port without inserting metal. Follow the maker guide for any replacement.
Test charging and normal use, then explain the result to the customer.

string-array.name: tips_printer
string-array.item: Write down the model and check paper, ink or toner, and any error lights.
Check the power and USB cable or that both devices use the same Wi-Fi.
Install the official driver for the correct printer and computer.
Clear stuck print jobs and print a test page.
Try the customer\'s usual document and test scanning if available.

string-array.name: tips_wifi
string-array.item: Ask whether the problem affects one device or everyone.
Check cables and lights. Restart normally; do not factory-reset without the owner\'s approval.
Check the Wi-Fi name and password with the owner. Keep provider settings before changing them.
Use the router\'s supported security settings and an owner-chosen strong password.
Test a website on two devices and show the owner how to reconnect.

string-array.name: tips_custom
string-array.item: Ask what the customer needs and write it down.
Record the device condition and any accessories received.
Agree on the work, price and any files that must be protected.
Do the agreed work, then test the result.
Explain what was done and check everything with the customer.
